const HexDigits := "0123456789abcdef"
const Backslash := "\"
const Letters := "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
const Digits := "0123456789"
const Printable := " !{DQ}#$%&'()*+,-./0123456789:;<=>?@ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ[\]^_`abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz{{|}}~"

class Field(int number, string type, string name, required := false, repeated := false, packed := false, group := "")
class EnumType()
    numbers := map<string, int>()
    names := map<int, string>()

class MessageType()
    fields := map<int, Field>()
    numbers := map<string, int>()

class Schema()
    enums := map<string, EnumType>()
    messages := map<string, MessageType>()

class Value(number := 0, int[] data := [], message := -1)
class Unknown(int number, int wire, raw := 0, int[] data := [])
class Message(string type)
    values := map<int, Value[]>()
    Unknown[] unknown := []

class Arena()
    Message[] messages := []

class Token(string kind, int column, text := "", number := 0, int[] data := [])
class Segment(Field field, index := -1)

void merge_message(const Schema schema, Arena &arena, int target, int source);
int[] encode_message(const Schema schema, const Arena arena, int message);
string message_notation(const Schema schema, const Arena arena, int message);
string json_message(const Schema schema, const Arena arena, int message);
int | error parse_message(const Schema schema, const Token[] tokens, int &position, string type, Arena &arena);
Value | error parse_element(const Schema schema, const Token[] tokens, int &position, const Field field, Arena &arena);
Value[] | error parse_field_value(const Schema schema, const Token[] tokens, int &position, const Field field, Arena &arena);

bool contains_word(const string[] words, string sought)
    for word := words[]
        if word == sought
            return true
    return false

MessageType message_type(const Schema schema, string name)
    match schema.messages.get(name)
        MessageType found
            return found
        none
            return MessageType()

EnumType enum_type(const Schema schema, string name)
    match schema.enums.get(name)
        EnumType found
            return found
        none
            return EnumType()

Field field_at(const MessageType type, int number)
    match type.fields.get(number)
        Field found
            return found
        none
            return Field(0, "", "")

Field named_field(const MessageType type, string name)
    match type.numbers.get(name)
        int number
            return field_at(type, number)
        none
            return Field(0, "", "")

Field[] fields(const Schema schema, string type)
    definition := message_type(schema, type)
    return [for number := definition.fields.keys().sorted()[] then field_at(definition, number)]

string kind(const Schema schema, string type)
    if schema.messages.has(type)
        return "message"
    if schema.enums.has(type)
        return "enum"
    if contains_word(["string", "bytes", "bool"], type)
        return type
    return "integer"

int wire_type(const Schema schema, string type)
    if type == "fixed32" or type == "sfixed32"
        return 5
    if type == "fixed64"
        return 1
    if type == "string" or type == "bytes" or schema.messages.has(type)
        return 2
    return 0

string wire_name(int wire)
    return if wire == 0 then "varint" elif wire == 1 then "i64" elif wire == 2 then "len" else "i32"

bool in_range(string type, int number)
    if type == "sint32" or type == "sfixed32"
        return -2147483648 <= number <= 2147483647
    if type == "sint64"
        return -4503599627370496 <= number <= 4503599627370495
    if type == "uint32" or type == "fixed32"
        return 0 <= number <= 4294967295
    return 0 <= number <= 9007199254740991

int zigzag(int value)
    return if value >= 0 then 2 * value else -2 * value - 1

int unzigzag(int value)
    return if value % 2 == 0 then value / 2 else -(value + 1) / 2

int hex_digit(string character)
    match HexDigits.find(character)
        nat index
            return int(index)
        none
            return -1

bool valid_hex_digits(string text)
    for: index < #text
        if hex_digit(text[index]) < 0
            return false
    return true

int[] hex_bytes(string text)
    int[] result := []
    for: 0 <= index < int(#text) step 2
        result = result.append(16 * hex_digit(text[index]) + hex_digit(text[index + 1]))
    return result

string byte_hex(int byte)
    return HexDigits[byte / 16] + HexDigits[byte % 16]

string hex_text(const int[] data, empty_hyphen := true)
    result := ""
    for byte := data[]
        result += byte_hex(byte)
    return if result == "" and empty_hyphen then "-" else result

int[] | error parse_hex(string text)
    if text == "-"
        return []
    if #text == 0 or #text % 2 != 0 or not valid_hex_digits(text)
        return error("invalid hex")
    return hex_bytes(text)

int[] varint_bytes(int value)
    remaining := value
    int[] result := []
    while remaining >= 128
        result = result.append(remaining % 128 + 128)
        remaining /= 128
    return result.append(remaining)

string quoted_bytes(const int[] data, json_escape := false)
    string result := DQ
    for byte := data[]
        if byte == 34
            result += Backslash + DQ
        elif byte == 92
            result += Backslash + Backslash
        elif byte == 10
            result += Backslash + "n"
        elif byte == 9
            result += Backslash + "t"
        elif 32 <= byte <= 126
            result += Printable[byte - 32]
        else
            result += Backslash + (if json_escape then "u00" else "x") + byte_hex(byte)
    return result + DQ

string enum_name(const Schema schema, string type, int number)
    definition := enum_type(schema, type)
    match definition.names.get(number)
        string name
            return name
        none
            return ""

Value[] items(const Arena arena, int message, int number)
    match arena.messages[message].values.get(number)
        Value[] found
            return found
        none
            return []

int new_message(Arena &arena, string type)
    index := int(#arena.messages)
    arena.messages = arena.messages.append(Message(type))
    return index

void set_items(Arena &arena, int message, int number, const Value[] values)
    if #values == 0
        .arena.messages[message].values.remove(number)
    else
        .arena.messages[message].values.set(number, values)

void remove_group(const Schema schema, Arena &arena, int message, const Field field)
    if field.group == ""
        return
    for other := fields(schema, arena.messages[message].type)[]
        if other.number != field.number and other.group == field.group
            .arena.messages[message].values.remove(other.number)

void apply_values(const Schema schema, Arena &arena, int target, const Field field, const Value[] values)
    remove_group(schema, &arena, target, field)
    old := items(arena, target, field.number)
    if field.repeated
        set_items(&arena, target, field.number, old.concat(values))
    elif schema.messages.has(field.type) and #old > 0
        merge_message(schema, &arena, old[0].message, values[0].message)
    else
        set_items(&arena, target, field.number, values)

void merge_message(const Schema schema, Arena &arena, int target, int source)
    for field := fields(schema, arena.messages[source].type)[]
        values := items(arena, source, field.number)
        if #values > 0
            apply_values(schema, &arena, target, field, values)
    arena.messages[target].unknown = arena.messages[target].unknown.concat(arena.messages[source].unknown)

void | error check_required(const Schema schema, const Arena arena, int message, prefix := "")
    for field := fields(schema, arena.messages[message].type)[]
        values := items(arena, message, field.number)
        if field.required and #values == 0
            return error("missing required field " + prefix + field.name)
        if schema.messages.has(field.type)
            for: index < #values
                suffix := if field.repeated then "[{index}]" else ""
                try check_required(schema, arena, values[index].message, prefix + field.name + suffix + ".")
    return void

int[] element_bytes(const Schema schema, const Arena arena, const Field field, const Value value)
    wire := wire_type(schema, field.type)
    if wire == 2
        payload := if schema.messages.has(field.type) then encode_message(schema, arena, value.message) else value.data
        return varint_bytes(int(#payload)).concat(payload)
    if wire == 0
        number := if field.type == "sint32" or field.type == "sint64" then zigzag(value.number) else value.number
        return varint_bytes(number)
    number := if value.number < 0 then value.number + 4294967296 else value.number
    int[] result := []
    width := if wire == 1 then 8 else 4
    for: index < width
        result = result.append(number % 256)
        number /= 256
    return result

int[] field_records(const Schema schema, const Arena arena, const Field field, const Value[] values)
    if #values == 0
        return []
    int[] result := []
    if field.packed
        for value := values[]
            result = result.concat(element_bytes(schema, arena, field, value))
        return varint_bytes(field.number * 8 + 2).concat(varint_bytes(int(#result))).concat(result)
    tag := varint_bytes(field.number * 8 + wire_type(schema, field.type))
    for value := values[]
        result = result.concat(tag).concat(element_bytes(schema, arena, field, value))
    return result

int[] encode_message(const Schema schema, const Arena arena, int message)
    int[] result := []
    for field := fields(schema, arena.messages[message].type)[]
        result = result.concat(field_records(schema, arena, field, items(arena, message, field.number)))
    for unknown := arena.messages[message].unknown[]
        result = result.concat(varint_bytes(unknown.number * 8 + unknown.wire))
        if unknown.wire == 0
            result = result.concat(varint_bytes(unknown.raw))
        elif unknown.wire == 2
            result = result.concat(varint_bytes(int(#unknown.data))).concat(unknown.data)
        else
            result = result.concat(unknown.data)
    return result

string value_notation(const Schema schema, const Arena arena, const Field field, const Value value)
    category := kind(schema, field.type)
    if category == "message"
        return message_notation(schema, arena, value.message)
    if category == "enum"
        return enum_name(schema, field.type, value.number)
    if category == "bool"
        return if value.number == 0 then "false" else "true"
    if category == "string"
        return quoted_bytes(value.data)
    if category == "bytes"
        return "<" + hex_text(value.data, false) + ">"
    return string(value.number)

string list_notation(const Schema schema, const Arena arena, const Field field, const Value[] values)
    text := [for value := values[] then value_notation(schema, arena, field, value)]
    return "[" + text.join(", ") + "]"

string message_notation(const Schema schema, const Arena arena, int message)
    string[] text := []
    for field := fields(schema, arena.messages[message].type)[]
        values := items(arena, message, field.number)
        if #values > 0
            value := if field.repeated then list_notation(schema, arena, field, values) else value_notation(schema, arena, field, values[0])
            text = text.append(field.name + ": " + value)
    return "{{" + text.join(", ") + "}}"

string raw_notation(const Unknown unknown)
    return if unknown.wire == 0 then string(unknown.raw) else "<" + hex_text(unknown.data, false) + ">"

void text_contents(const Schema schema, const Arena arena, int message, int depth, string[] &lines)
    string indent := " " * nat(2 * depth)
    for field := fields(schema, arena.messages[message].type)[]
        for value := items(arena, message, field.number)[]
            if schema.messages.has(field.type)
                lines = lines.append(indent + field.name + " {{")
                text_contents(schema, arena, value.message, depth + 1, &lines)
                lines = lines.append(indent + "}}")
            else
                lines = lines.append(indent + field.name + ": " + value_notation(schema, arena, field, value))
    for unknown := arena.messages[message].unknown[]
        lines = lines.append(indent + "{unknown.number} " + wire_name(unknown.wire) + " " + raw_notation(unknown))

string text_message(const Schema schema, const Arena arena, int message)
    lines := [arena.messages[message].type + " {{"]
    text_contents(schema, arena, message, 1, &lines)
    return lines.append("}}").join(NL)

string base64_text(const int[] data)
    alphabet := "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
    result := ""
    for: 0 <= offset < int(#data) step 3
        remaining := int(#data) - offset
        second := if remaining >= 2 then data[offset + 1] else 0
        third := if remaining >= 3 then data[offset + 2] else 0
        number := data[offset] * 65536 + second * 256 + third
        result += alphabet[number / 262144] + alphabet[(number / 4096) % 64]
        result += if remaining >= 2 then alphabet[(number / 64) % 64] else "="
        result += if remaining >= 3 then alphabet[number % 64] else "="
    return result

string json_key(string name)
    result := ""
    capitalize := false
    for: index < #name
        character := name[index]
        if character == "_"
            capitalize = true
            continue
        if capitalize
            match "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz".find(character)
                nat position
                    character = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"[position]
                none
                    void
        result += character
        capitalize = false
    return result

string json_value(const Schema schema, const Arena arena, const Field field, const Value value)
    category := kind(schema, field.type)
    if category == "message"
        return json_message(schema, arena, value.message)
    if category == "string"
        return quoted_bytes(value.data, true)
    if category == "bytes"
        return DQ + base64_text(value.data) + DQ
    text := value_notation(schema, arena, field, value)
    return if category == "enum" or contains_word(["uint64", "sint64", "fixed64"], field.type) then DQ + text + DQ else text

string json_message(const Schema schema, const Arena arena, int message)
    string[] result := []
    for field := fields(schema, arena.messages[message].type)[]
        values := items(arena, message, field.number)
        if #values == 0
            continue
        rendered := [for value := values[] then json_value(schema, arena, field, value)]
        text := if field.repeated then "[" + rendered.join(",") + "]" else rendered[0]
        result = result.append(DQ + json_key(field.name) + DQ + ":" + text)
    return "{{" + result.join(",") + "}}"

int | error read_varint(const int[] data, int &position, int end)
    start := position
    value := 0
    factor := 1
    for: index < 8
        if position >= end
            return error("truncated varint at byte {start}")
        byte := data[position]
        position += 1
        value += (byte % 128) * factor
        if byte < 128
            if value >= 9007199254740992
                return error("varint too large at byte {start}")
            return value
        if index == 7
            return error("varint too long at byte {start}")
        factor *= 128
    return error("varint too long at byte {start}")

int[] | error read_fixed(const int[] data, int &position, int end, int wire)
    width := if wire == 1 then 8 else 4
    if end - position < width
        return error("truncated " + wire_name(wire) + " at byte {position}")
    start := position
    position += width
    return data[start:<position]

int little_endian(const int[] data)
    result := 0
    factor := 1
    for byte := data[]
        result += byte * factor
        factor *= 256
    return result

Value | error scalar_value(const Schema schema, const Field field, int number, int position)
    category := kind(schema, field.type)
    if category == "bool"
        if number > 1
            return error("value out of range at byte {position}")
        return Value(number)
    if category == "enum"
        definition := enum_type(schema, field.type)
        if not definition.names.has(number)
            return error("unknown enum number at byte {position}")
        return Value(number)
    converted := number
    if field.type == "sint32" or field.type == "sint64"
        converted = unzigzag(number)
    elif field.type == "sfixed32" and number >= 2147483648
        converted -= 4294967296
    if not in_range(field.type, converted)
        return error("value out of range at byte {position}")
    return Value(converted)

int | error read_message(const Schema schema, const int[] data, int &position, int end, string type, Arena &arena, bool explaining, int depth, string[] &lines)
    message := new_message(&arena, type)
    definition := message_type(schema, type)
    while position < end
        start := position
        tag := try read_varint(data, &position, end)
        number := tag / 8
        wire := tag % 8
        if number == 0
            return error("invalid field number at byte {start}")
        if wire != 0 and wire != 1 and wire != 2 and wire != 5
            return error("invalid wire type at byte {start}")
        field := field_at(definition, number)
        known := field.number != 0
        expected := if known then wire_type(schema, field.type) else wire
        packed := known and field.repeated and expected != 2 and wire == 2
        if known and wire != expected and not packed
            return error("wire type mismatch at byte {start}")
        value_start := position
        raw := 0
        int[] payload := []
        if wire == 0
            raw = try read_varint(data, &position, end)
        elif wire == 2
            length_start := position
            length := try read_varint(data, &position, end)
            value_start = position
            if position + length > end
                return error("length past end at byte {length_start}")
            payload = data[position:<position + length]
            position += length
        else
            payload = try read_fixed(data, &position, end, wire)
        string header := " " * nat(2 * depth) + "{start} {number} " + (if known then field.name else "?") + " " + wire_name(wire)
        if wire == 2
            header += " {#payload}"
        if not known
            unknown := Unknown(number, wire, raw, payload)
            arena.messages[message].unknown = arena.messages[message].unknown.append(unknown)
            if explaining
                lines = lines.append(header + " " + raw_notation(unknown))
            continue
        category := kind(schema, field.type)
        Value[] values := []
        if category == "message"
            if explaining
                lines = lines.append(header)
            nested_position := value_start
            nested := try read_message(schema, data, &nested_position, position, field.type, &arena, explaining, depth + 1, &lines)
            values = [Value(message = nested)]
        elif packed
            packed_position := value_start
            while packed_position < position
                element_start := packed_position
                number_value := 0
                if expected == 0
                    number_value = try read_varint(data, &packed_position, position)
                else
                    fixed := try read_fixed(data, &packed_position, position, expected)
                    number_value = little_endian(fixed)
                converted := try scalar_value(schema, field, number_value, element_start)
                values = values.append(converted)
            if explaining
                detail := header + " packed"
                for value := values[]
                    detail += " " + value_notation(schema, arena, field, value)
                lines = lines.append(detail)
        else
            converted := Value()
            if category == "string" or category == "bytes"
                if category == "string"
                    for: index < #payload
                        if payload[index] >= 128
                            return error("invalid string at byte {value_start + int(index)}")
                converted = Value(data = payload)
            else
                number_value := if wire == 0 then raw else little_endian(payload)
                converted = try scalar_value(schema, field, number_value, value_start)
            values = [converted]
            if explaining
                lines = lines.append(header + " " + value_notation(schema, arena, field, converted))
        if not explaining
            apply_values(schema, &arena, message, field, values)
    return message

int | error decode(const Schema schema, const int[] data, string type, Arena &arena)
    position := 0
    string[] ignored := []
    message := try read_message(schema, data, &position, int(#data), type, &arena, false, 0, &ignored)
    try check_required(schema, arena, message)
    return message

Token[] | error tokenize(string text)
    Token[] result := []
    position := 0
    size := int(#text)
    while position < size
        character := text[position]
        if character == " "
            position += 1
            continue
        start := position
        column := start + 1
        if "{{}}[]:,".contains(character)
            result = result.append(Token("symbol", column, character))
            position += 1
        elif character == DQ
            position += 1
            int[] data := []
            closed := false
            while position < size
                current := text[position]
                if current == DQ
                    closed = true
                    position += 1
                    break
                if current != Backslash
                    data = data.append(current.codepoints()[0])
                    position += 1
                    continue
                position += 1
                if position >= size
                    return error("syntax error at column {column}")
                escape := text[position]
                position += 1
                if escape == DQ
                    data = data.append(34)
                elif escape == Backslash
                    data = data.append(92)
                elif escape == "n"
                    data = data.append(10)
                elif escape == "t"
                    data = data.append(9)
                elif escape == "x" and position + 2 <= size
                    digits := text[position:<position + 2]
                    if not valid_hex_digits(digits)
                        return error("syntax error at column {column}")
                    byte := 16 * hex_digit(digits[0]) + hex_digit(digits[1])
                    if byte >= 128
                        return error("syntax error at column {column}")
                    data = data.append(byte)
                    position += 2
                else
                    return error("syntax error at column {column}")
            if not closed
                return error("syntax error at column {column}")
            result = result.append(Token("string", column, data = data))
        elif character == "<"
            position += 1
            begin := position
            while position < size and text[position] != ">"
                position += 1
            if position == size
                return error("syntax error at column {column}")
            digits := text[begin:<position]
            if #digits % 2 != 0 or not valid_hex_digits(digits)
                return error("syntax error at column {column}")
            result = result.append(Token("bytes", column, data = hex_bytes(digits)))
            position += 1
        elif character == "-" or Digits.contains(character)
            if character == "-"
                position += 1
            begin := position
            while position < size and Digits.contains(text[position])
                position += 1
            if position == begin
                return error("syntax error at column {column}")
            number := int(text[start:<position])
            result = result.append(Token("integer", column, number = number))
        elif Letters.contains(character) or character == "_"
            position += 1
            while position < size and (Letters.contains(text[position]) or Digits.contains(text[position]) or text[position] == "_")
                position += 1
            result = result.append(Token("name", column, text[start:<position]))
        else
            return error("syntax error at column {column}")
    return result.append(Token("end", size + 1))

string token_shape(const Token token)
    if token.kind == "symbol"
        return if token.text == "{{" then "message" elif token.text == "[" then "list" else ""
    if token.kind == "name"
        return if token.text == "true" or token.text == "false" then "boolean" else "name"
    return if token.kind == "end" then "" else token.kind

bool at_symbol(const Token[] tokens, int position, string symbol)
    return tokens[position].kind == "symbol" and tokens[position].text == symbol

void | error expect_symbol(const Token[] tokens, int &position, string symbol)
    if not at_symbol(tokens, position, symbol)
        return error("syntax error at column {tokens[position].column}")
    position += 1
    return void

Value | error parse_element(const Schema schema, const Token[] tokens, int &position, const Field field, Arena &arena)
    token := tokens[position]
    shape := token_shape(token)
    category := kind(schema, field.type)
    expected := if category == "enum" then "name" elif category == "bool" then "boolean" else category
    if shape == ""
        return error("syntax error at column {token.column}")
    if shape != expected
        return error("type mismatch at column {token.column}")
    if shape == "message"
        message := try parse_message(schema, tokens, &position, field.type, &arena)
        return Value(message = message)
    position += 1
    if shape == "integer"
        if not in_range(field.type, token.number)
            return error("out of range at column {token.column}")
        return Value(token.number)
    if shape == "boolean"
        return Value(if token.text == "true" then 1 else 0)
    if shape == "name"
        definition := enum_type(schema, field.type)
        match definition.numbers.get(token.text)
            int number
                return Value(number)
            none
                return error("unknown enum value at column {token.column}")
    return Value(data = token.data)

Value[] | error parse_field_value(const Schema schema, const Token[] tokens, int &position, const Field field, Arena &arena)
    if not field.repeated
        value := try parse_element(schema, tokens, &position, field, &arena)
        return [value]
    token := tokens[position]
    shape := token_shape(token)
    if shape == ""
        return error("syntax error at column {token.column}")
    if shape != "list"
        return error("type mismatch at column {token.column}")
    position += 1
    Value[] result := []
    if not at_symbol(tokens, position, "]")
        value := try parse_element(schema, tokens, &position, field, &arena)
        result = result.append(value)
        while at_symbol(tokens, position, ",")
            position += 1
            following := try parse_element(schema, tokens, &position, field, &arena)
            result = result.append(following)
    try expect_symbol(tokens, &position, "]")
    return result

int | error parse_message(const Schema schema, const Token[] tokens, int &position, string type, Arena &arena)
    try expect_symbol(tokens, &position, "{{")
    message := new_message(&arena, type)
    definition := message_type(schema, type)
    distinct<int> seen
    distinct<string> groups
    if not at_symbol(tokens, position, "}}")
        while true
            token := tokens[position]
            if token.kind != "name"
                return error("syntax error at column {token.column}")
            field := named_field(definition, token.text)
            if field.number == 0
                return error("unknown field at column {token.column}")
            if seen.has(field.number)
                return error("duplicate field at column {token.column}")
            if field.group != "" and groups.has(field.group)
                return error("oneof conflict at column {token.column}")
            .seen.add(field.number)
            if field.group != ""
                .groups.add(field.group)
            position += 1
            try expect_symbol(tokens, &position, ":")
            values := try parse_field_value(schema, tokens, &position, field, &arena)
            set_items(&arena, message, field.number, values)
            if not at_symbol(tokens, position, ",")
                break
            position += 1
    closing := tokens[position].column
    try expect_symbol(tokens, &position, "}}")
    for field := fields(schema, type)[]
        if field.required and not seen.has(field.number)
            return error("missing required field {field.name} at column {closing}")
    return message

void | error finish_literal(const Token[] tokens, int position)
    if tokens[position].kind != "end"
        return error("syntax error at column {tokens[position].column}")
    return void

Segment[] | error parse_path(const Schema schema, string type, string text)
    current_type := type
    Segment[] result := []
    parts := text.split(".")
    for: position < #parts
        part := parts[position]
        name := part
        index := -1
        match part.find("[")
            nat bracket
                if not part.ends_with("]")
                    return error("invalid path")
                name = part[0:<bracket]
                digits := part[int(bracket) + 1:<int(#part) - 1]
                if not (1 <= #digits <= 6)
                    return error("invalid path")
                for: digit_index < #digits
                    if not Digits.contains(digits[digit_index])
                        return error("invalid path")
                index = int(digits)
            none
                void
        field := named_field(message_type(schema, current_type), name)
        if field.number == 0 or (index >= 0 and not field.repeated)
            return error("invalid path")
        result = result.append(Segment(field, index))
        if position + 1 < #parts
            if not schema.messages.has(field.type) or (field.repeated and index < 0)
                return error("invalid path")
            current_type = field.type
    return result

bool whole_path(const Segment[] path)
    last := path[-1]
    return last.field.repeated and last.index < 0

string get_path(const Schema schema, const Arena arena, int message, const Segment[] path)
    current := message
    whole := whole_path(path)
    for: position < #path
        segment := path[position]
        values := items(arena, current, segment.field.number)
        index := if segment.index < 0 then 0 else segment.index
        if position + 1 == #path and whole
            return list_notation(schema, arena, segment.field, values)
        if index >= int(#values)
            return if whole then "[]" else "(none)"
        if position + 1 == #path
            return value_notation(schema, arena, segment.field, values[index])
        current = values[index].message
    return "(none)"

void | error patch_path(const Schema schema, Arena &arena, int message, const Segment[] path, const Value[] replacement)
    current := message
    for: position < #path
        segment := path[position]
        field := segment.field
        values := items(arena, current, field.number)
        last := position + 1 == #path
        if field.repeated and segment.index >= 0
            if segment.index >= int(#values)
                return error("index out of range")
            if last
                values[segment.index] = replacement[0]
                set_items(&arena, current, field.number, values)
                return
            current = values[segment.index].message
        elif last
            remove_group(schema, &arena, current, field)
            set_items(&arena, current, field.number, replacement)
            return
        else
            if #values == 0
                created := new_message(&arena, field.type)
                values = [Value(message = created)]
                remove_group(schema, &arena, current, field)
                set_items(&arena, current, field.number, values)
            current = values[0].message
    return void

void clear_path(Arena &arena, int message, const Segment[] path)
    current := message
    for: position < #path
        segment := path[position]
        values := items(arena, current, segment.field.number)
        index := if segment.index < 0 then 0 else segment.index
        if position + 1 == #path
            if segment.index < 0
                set_items(&arena, current, segment.field.number, [])
            elif index < int(#values)
                values = values[0:<index].concat(values[index + 1:])
                set_items(&arena, current, segment.field.number, values)
            return
        if index >= int(#values)
            return
        current = values[index].message

void compare_messages(const Schema schema, const Arena arena, int first, int second, string prefix, string[] &lines)
    for field := fields(schema, arena.messages[first].type)[]
        left := items(arena, first, field.number)
        right := items(arena, second, field.number)
        count := if #left > #right then #left else #right
        for: index < count
            path := prefix + field.name + (if field.repeated then "[{index}]" else "")
            has_left := index < #left
            has_right := index < #right
            if has_left and has_right and schema.messages.has(field.type)
                compare_messages(schema, arena, left[index].message, right[index].message, path + ".", &lines)
            elif not has_left or not has_right or left[index] != right[index]
                before := if has_left then value_notation(schema, arena, field, left[index]) else "(none)"
                after := if has_right then value_notation(schema, arena, field, right[index]) else "(none)"
                lines = lines.append(path + ": " + before + " -> " + after)

void schema_fields(const Schema schema, string type, const string[] chain, int depth, string[] &lines)
    for field := fields(schema, type)[]
        qualifier := ""
        if field.required
            qualifier = "required "
        elif field.packed
            qualifier = "repeated packed "
        elif field.repeated
            qualifier = "repeated "
        elif field.group != ""
            qualifier = "oneof " + field.group + " "
        string line := " " * nat(2 * depth) + "{field.number} {field.name}: " + qualifier + field.type
        if schema.enums.has(field.type)
            definition := enum_type(schema, field.type)
            string[] values := []
            for number := definition.names.keys().sorted()[]
                values = values.append(enum_name(schema, field.type, number) + "={number}")
            line += " (" + values.join(", ") + ")"
        recursive := schema.messages.has(field.type) and contains_word(chain, field.type)
        lines = lines.append(line + (if recursive then " (recursive)" else ""))
        if schema.messages.has(field.type) and not recursive
            schema_fields(schema, field.type, chain.append(field.type), depth + 1, &lines)

string tail_after(string line, int separators)
    seen := 0
    for: index < #line
        if line[index] == " "
            seen += 1
            if seen == separators
                return line[index + 1:]
    return ""

int | error command_number(string text, bool signed)
    start := if text.starts_with("-") then 1 else 0
    count := int(#text) - start
    if not (1 <= count <= 18)
        return error("invalid number")
    for: start <= index < int(#text)
        if not Digits.contains(text[index])
            return error("invalid number")
    number := int(text)
    if (signed and not in_range("sint64", number)) or (not signed and not in_range("uint64", number))
        return error("invalid number")
    return number

string | error execute(const Schema schema, string line)
    words := line.split(" ")
    command := words[0]
    expected := 0
    if contains_word(["VARINT", "ZIGZAG", "SCHEMA"], command)
        expected = 2
    elif contains_word(["ENCODE", "SIZE", "DECODE", "LITERAL", "JSON", "CANON", "EXPLAIN"], command)
        expected = 3
    elif contains_word(["GET", "CLEAR", "MERGE", "DIFF"], command)
        expected = 4
    elif command == "PATCH"
        expected = 5
    else
        return error("unknown command")
    text_argument := command == "ENCODE" or command == "SIZE" or command == "PATCH"
    if int(#words) < expected or (not text_argument and int(#words) != expected)
        return error("wrong number of arguments")
    if command == "VARINT" or command == "ZIGZAG"
        number := try command_number(words[1], command == "ZIGZAG")
        if command == "VARINT"
            return hex_text(varint_bytes(number))
        converted := zigzag(number)
        return "{converted} " + hex_text(varint_bytes(converted))
    type := words[1]
    if not schema.messages.has(type)
        return error("unknown message type")
    if command == "SCHEMA"
        lines := [type]
        schema_fields(schema, type, [type], 1, &lines)
        return lines.join(NL)
    int[] data := []
    int[] second_data := []
    if command != "ENCODE" and command != "SIZE"
        data = try parse_hex(words[2])
        if command == "MERGE" or command == "DIFF"
            second_data = try parse_hex(words[3])
    Segment[] path := []
    if command == "GET" or command == "PATCH" or command == "CLEAR"
        path = try parse_path(schema, type, words[3])
    arena := Arena()
    if command == "ENCODE" or command == "SIZE"
        tokens := try tokenize(tail_after(line, 2))
        position := 0
        message := try parse_message(schema, tokens, &position, type, &arena)
        try finish_literal(tokens, position)
        encoded := encode_message(schema, arena, message)
        if command == "ENCODE"
            return hex_text(encoded)
        result := string(#encoded)
        for field := fields(schema, type)[]
            values := items(arena, message, field.number)
            if #values > 0
                records := field_records(schema, arena, field, values)
                result += " {field.name}={#records}"
        return result
    if command == "EXPLAIN"
        position := 0
        string[] lines := []
        ignored := try read_message(schema, data, &position, int(#data), type, &arena, true, 0, &lines)
        return if #lines == 0 then "(empty)" else lines.join(NL)
    if command == "MERGE"
        data = data.concat(second_data)
    message := 0
    if command == "DIFF"
        match decode(schema, data, type, &arena)
            int decoded
                message = decoded
            error problem
                return error(problem.message + " in first")
        second := 0
        match decode(schema, second_data, type, &arena)
            int decoded
                second = decoded
            error problem
                return error(problem.message + " in second")
        string[] lines := []
        compare_messages(schema, arena, message, second, "", &lines)
        return if #lines == 0 then "SAME" else lines.join(NL)
    message = try decode(schema, data, type, &arena)
    if command == "DECODE" or command == "MERGE"
        return text_message(schema, arena, message)
    if command == "LITERAL"
        return message_notation(schema, arena, message)
    if command == "JSON"
        return json_message(schema, arena, message)
    if command == "CANON"
        return hex_text(encode_message(schema, arena, message))
    if command == "GET"
        return get_path(schema, arena, message, path)
    if command == "PATCH"
        tokens := try tokenize(tail_after(line, 4))
        position := 0
        last := path[-1]
        Value[] replacement := []
        if whole_path(path)
            replacement = try parse_field_value(schema, tokens, &position, last.field, &arena)
        else
            value := try parse_element(schema, tokens, &position, last.field, &arena)
            replacement = [value]
        try finish_literal(tokens, position)
        try patch_path(schema, &arena, message, path, replacement)
    else
        clear_path(&arena, message, path)
    try check_required(schema, arena, message)
    return hex_text(encode_message(schema, arena, message))

schema := Schema()
current_type := ""
while true
    string line
    scan(&line)
    if line == "END SCHEMA"
        break
    words := line.split(" ")
    if words[0] == "ENUM"
        current_type = words[1]
        .schema.enums.set(current_type, EnumType())
    elif words[0] == "MESSAGE"
        current_type = words[1]
        .schema.messages.set(current_type, MessageType())
    elif words[0] == "VALUE"
        definition := enum_type(schema, current_type)
        number := int(words[2])
        .definition.numbers.set(words[1], number)
        .definition.names.set(number, words[1])
        .schema.enums.set(current_type, definition)
    elif words[0] == "FIELD"
        definition := message_type(schema, current_type)
        number := int(words[1])
        required := #words >= 5 and words[4] == "REQUIRED"
        repeated := #words >= 5 and words[4] == "REPEATED"
        packed := #words == 6 and words[5] == "PACKED"
        group := if #words == 6 and words[4] == "ONEOF" then words[5] else ""
        field := Field(number, words[2], words[3], required, repeated, packed, group)
        .definition.fields.set(number, field)
        .definition.numbers.set(words[3], number)
        .schema.messages.set(current_type, definition)
int count
scan(&count)
for: command_index < count
    string line
    scan(&line)
    match execute(schema, line)
        string output
            println(output)
        error problem
            println("ERROR " + problem.message)
